blocks.text:
Meet at Santiago Airport and transfer to the hotel.

After checking in, begin a private sightseeing tour of Santiago with an English-speaking guide, lasting about 4 hours.

The evening is free. You may choose to have dinner at a restaurant serving local cuisine.

Overnight at the hotel.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, we set off for the Pacific coast.

The first part of the day is spent in Valparaíso, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The group tour is led by an English-speaking guide and includes a walk through the city streets.

We then head to Viña del Mar, where we stroll along the waterfront and watch the pelicans.

After returning to Santiago, you can choose to visit a winery near the capital. The visit includes a Chilean wine tasting, a walk through the vineyards and an introduction to the estate's history.

Overnight at the hotel in Santiago.
